name: Full Smile
verdict: Leads dropped 19.44% week-over-week while CPL rose 24.14%, pointing to softening efficiency on Meta (the sole active channel), likely driven by audience fatigue or creative wear on the top campaign "BWS - Instant Leads - Awareness" which consumed $884.95 of the $1,444.19 28-day spend. GBP engagement also fell sharply at -57.41%, suggesting reduced organic brand interest compounding the paid slowdown.

performance.verdict: Meta efficiency breaking down; GHL pipeline gap hides true lead-to-patient conversion risk.

findings.text: CPL rose 24.14% week-over-week with spend flat at $59.88/day; leads fell from ~18 to ~14 in the last 7d window — efficiency is deteriorating, not stabilising.
3-day signal (Aug 6–8): leads averaged 3.3/day vs 4.7/day prior 3 days (Aug 3–5); spend held ~$50/day — falling leads on flat spend confirms fatigue, not budget loss.

5 overdue SOW milestones past due (LSA over-counting 7/27, caption guide 7/28, phone-match attribution 8/7, credentials rotation 8/7, Saturday sync 8/1 unconfirmed closed) — each blocks the August scoreboard or client trust.
GHL shows 129 leads vs only 98 opportunities created (28d) and 0 appointments logged — leads arriving but intake not converting them; this is a pipeline intake leak, not an ads problem.
GBP actions fell 57.41% week-over-week; last 3 days show 0 GBP actions (Aug 6–8) — organic brand demand has stalled and is no longer supporting paid lead flow.

suggestions.text: Introduce at least 1 new creative into BWS Instant Leads campaign; current set is delivering 3.3 leads/day vs 4.7 just 3 days prior on same spend.
suggestions.monday_update: CPL rose 24.14% week-over-week and the 3-day lead average dropped from 4.7 to 3.3/day while spend held at ~$50/day — a classic fatigue pattern on the BWS Instant Leads Awareness campaign ($884.95 of 28-day spend). Launch at least one new creative variant (new hook or offer angle) into the existing ad set by Aug 12. Success check: CPL returns below $11.20 (28-day baseline) within 7 days of new creative going live. Re-evaluate Aug 16.

suggestions.text: Repair GHL intake: 129 leads arrived but only 98 opportunities created and 0 appointments logged — 31+ leads unaccounted for in pipeline.
suggestions.monday_update: 28-day data shows 129 Meta leads versus only 98 GHL opportunities created and zero appointments recorded — at least 31 leads have no downstream tracking. Audit the lead-to-opportunity automation and the appointment booking step in GHL; confirm Lily's intake process and the new intake hire workflow are correctly routing all form fills to scheduled appointments. Success check: opportunities created matches leads within ±5% and at least 1 appointment appears in GHL by Aug 14 Lily sync. This is an intake problem, not an ads problem.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP actions: 0 actions for 3 consecutive days (Aug 6–8) after 57.41% weekly drop — do not shift budget until cause is known.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP recorded 0 actions on Aug 6, 7, and 8 after a 57.41% week-over-week decline. This removes an organic floor that has historically supported lead flow alongside paid. No budget action is warranted yet — first confirm whether the GBP listing has a visibility or suspension issue, or whether a post/content cadence lapsed. Re-check Aug 12: if GBP actions remain at 0 for 7 consecutive days, escalate as a listing issue to the SEO/GBP lead.
